facts.fact: The Government of Cabo Verde states that electronic public procurement has existed since 2020, with Central State Administration procedures progressively carried out through the official public purchasing portal.
facts.system: official public procurement portal (portal oficial de compras públicas)

facts.fact: The Government of Cabo Verde states that a new e-procurement platform was awarded to ACIN-iCloud Solutions for CVE 70,000,000 over four years, to extend the platform to local administration and autonomous services and funds.

systems.tiers: Central Administration, Local Administration, Autonomous Services and Funds
